Metaphor Search API is compelling when the real need isn’t just finding links, but quickly turning the open web into usable text for downstream LLM tasks. It pairs search with a simple path to fetch and parse page contents, which can replace a lot of brittle scraping and browsing code.

Compared with AnySearch’s focus on structured, de-duplicated retrieval results, Metaphor’s value is speed and simplicity for “search, then read.” That makes it a practical alternative for agents that need to ingest articles, docs, or posts and immediately summarize, extract entities, or run classification. results.title: Olostep: Web search, scraping and crawling for AI | Product Hunt
results.content:
Search asked you to do the rest. You typed a query, got some links back, and then opened the tabs, read, compared, and pieced it together yourself. In an agentic search world, what comes back isn't links, and isn't an answer. It's the work, done: hundreds of sources searched, pages read, fields extracted, conflicts resolved, output structured and delivered.   
The web's second user is arriving, at machine scale. Everything it needs to work has to be built again. The data infrastructure is where we start. We are starting with a series of APIs to search, scrape, crawl, map, monitor, and turn the web into clean data for AI

1

3

#### What's great [...] 1

Gal Dayan

#### What's great

the natural language search on top of scrape/crawl/map is the part that stood out to me - most web data APIs make you write selectors or at least think in URLs, this one lets you just describe what you want. having monitor built in for price/DOM change tracking as one product instead of stitching together a scraper plus a separate cron job is a real time saver for small teams.

#### What needs improvement

the docs link the maker shared in the comments is helpful but it'd be nice to see the pricing tiers broken out by request volume right on the product page instead of having to click through to the site - would save a step for anyone just comparing options.

#### vs Alternatives [...] Arslan Ali

Hey! I'm Arslan, one of the cofounders of Olostep. We are building Web Data Infrastructure for AI.   
  
We believe the Web is the backbone of all businesses and where humanity's collective knowledge resides. Humans have used it for other 30 years. Now we have a new user and consumer on the web: AI agents.   
  
These thinking machines need a new infrastructure custom built for them to allow them to complete actual work.   
  
We are starting with a suite of web data APIs to allow agents to search, extract and structure data from the Web.   
  
You can try the product for free from our website: olostep.com  
If you have any question feel free to reach out on Slack  
  
Thanks. Excited to see what you and the AI agents deployed in your businesses will build with it!
